notes: This release adds Discord notifications. On the Activity page, under the Webhooks tab, paste a Discord webhook URL, tick what you want to hear about and save, and the app posts to your channel when it happens: GM nearby, GM interaction, Character died, Disconnected while AUTO was armed, Attention required, Recovered and farming resumed, Incoming whisper, Party invite, Trade request, Timed farming report, Auto-sell completed and Auto-sell failed. Each client can have its own webhook and Send test posts a sample. Whisper notifications never include what was said unless you tick Include whisper text, which is off. The farming report, the recovered notification and both auto sell notifications are also off until you tick them. Your webhook URL is stored encrypted on your machine and is only ever shown back to you masked. The session kill count on the client overview now comes from the game's own counter instead of from what the bot saw die, deaths are counted the same way for the Character died notification, and boss summoning can now confirm a kill from that counter. On the Battle page, release skills get a tick box to cast only while their matching buff is missing, off until you tick it. Preferences gains a Multi-client identity row showing the identity the game reports for each client. Auto sell trips now record how many units they sold, the gold made and a breakdown by category. On the Item Logic page an item's Pickup is one switch now: on collects it, off follows its category, and an item its category would collect but this rule excludes shows an Excluded from its category badge.
